title: S10 instrumentation report
description: architecture.md S10. report-only: for each DTO of a supported change.type, either a proposed diff (never written to the target repo) or a stated refusal reason. fix: the same verification, but a successful result writes the file and creates one commit per DTO (commit_sha present); any failure past verification -- syntax-invalid content, a git error -- rolls back cleanly (docs/decisions/005-sp4-agent-mutation.md's own contract) and is recorded as status:'failed', never a silent skip.

results.description: One entry per DTO in the input implementation_dto.json, in the same order. Empty array is valid (no DTOs given).

status.description: applied: report-only produced a diff (not written); fix wrote the file and committed it (commit_sha set). refused: agent checked preconditions/anchor against the real file and declined, with a reason -- SP4's dto-003 case, a correct outcome, not a bug. unsupported: change.type isn't one of the 4 this phase covers -- never attempted, not a silent skip. failed: the agent session errored, the agent's proposed content didn't parse, or (fix mode only) git itself rejected the commit -- in fix mode this always means a clean rollback happened, never a half-applied file.

diff.description: report-only only: proposed unified diff, present only when status is 'applied'. Never written to the target repo.

commit_sha.description: fix only: the commit created for this DTO, present only when status is 'applied'.

reason.description: Required context for refused/unsupported/failed; null for applied.

syntax_valid.description: ast.parse() sanity check on the agent's proposed patched file content, present only when a patch was produced (status 'applied', or 'failed' when this specific check is why). Informational in report-only mode (never commits regardless); a hard pre-commit gate in fix mode (syntax_valid:false is never committed) -- SP4 found py_compile-equivalent checks insufficient for semantic bugs, so even in fix mode this only catches the syntactic half, not oversold as more.
